text:
lee: quick note from the dash review: two things tripped up the PMs — the sampling label and the p95 line visibility on the heatmap.

nina: agreed. PM asked if sampling=0.5 means 50% or 0.5%  we should make it explicit: `Sampling: 0.5% (1 in 200)` or `50% (1 in 2)` depending on value.

omar: UX idea: show human-readable plus raw: `Sampling: 0.5% — 1/200` so both audiences are covered.

lee: also, the p95 line disappearing into the orange band is a real problem. either add a drop shadow or change stroke to dashed white when over warm colors.

nina: drop shadow might hurt small screens. what about adaptive stroke: if underlying bucket luminance < 40% use white 2px solid else use #0b0b0b 2px solid. css can handle it if we compute luminance server-side and set a class.

omar: adaptive stroke + optional toggle in the heatmap menu: "Percentile overlay: on/auto/off". default auto.

lee: quick copy tweak: the p95 tooltip currently: `p95: 120` — change to `p95 (95th percentile) — 120 ms` and put a small subtitle with sample size `based on 8.2k calls`.

nina: good call. also the primary stat could show `p50 / p95` compactly: `45ms / 120ms` under the main label to avoid users thinking it's average.

omar: about presets: people asked for fidelity presets (Economy / Balanced / Fidelity) instead of Low/Medium/High because it communicates tradeoffs. quick microcopy for the dropdown: "Economy — max throughput, best cost; Fidelity — preserve tail latency accuracy."

lee: nice. add a tiny explanatory tooltip on hover "Why does fidelity matter?" linking to docs.

ui-bot: Prototype snapshot: https://staging.redwood.dev/preview/1985002468 (overlay: auto, presets: Economy/Balanced/Fidelity).

nina: accessibility: make sure preset buttons have aria-pressed and visible focus ring (4px). Also scrubber thumb hit-target to 24px min.

omar: keyboard: scrubber arrows move 1s, shift+arrow 15s, alt+arrow 5m. agree on having that in an accessible tooltip.

lee: mobile: hide overlay by default and show a condensed sparkline above the heatmap; give an affordance to toggle overlay on if they want.

nina: color tokens proposal (very rough): `--hm-0: #f7fbff, --hm-1: #e6f0ff, --hm-2: #fff7e6, --hm-3: #ffd9b3, --hm-4: #b84b3a`. Will run contrast check.

omar: please run Deque and post results. If extreme bucket fails contrast, add a 1px inner stroke to buckets at that threshold.

lee: owners: nina (copy + presets microcopy + accessibility checklist), omar (interactions + overlay rules + keyboard), nina+omar pair on token pass for contrast. Can we sync Thursday 9:30? 15m.

nina: yep. i'll draft the tooltip strings and the small copy changes tonight.

omar: i'll prototype the adaptive stroke and the presets in figma and push to staging.

ui-bot: Note: user-testing booked Thu 11am (5 participants)  recording on.

lee: thanks all. small ask: keep the p95 label consistent across charts (alerts, traces) so PMs stop hunting for definitions.

nina: agreed  i'll add global copy token `metrics.p95.label`.
